# BRAINGAIN

> > BRAINGAIN offers premium adjustable dumbbells, kettlebells, and home gym equipment bundles, founded by Adil & Kareem to bring professional fitness solutions to home workouts.

BRAINGAIN specializes in space-saving adjustable fitness equipment including their flagship 40kg and 24kg adjustable dumbbells, 18kg adjustable kettlebells, and the Pro Gym Bundle. The company serves UK, European, and North American markets with comprehensive product support and custom bundle options.

## Key Topics

- Adjustable dumbbells (40kg, 24kg, 32.5kg, 12.5kg)
- Adjustable kettlebells (18kg)
- BRAINGAIN Pro Gym Bundle
- Home gym equipment & fitness bundles
- Adjustable dumbbell rack & bench
- Space-saving workout equipment
- Custom bundle builder
- Founded by Adil & Kareem
- Multi-region support (UK, Europe, North America)
- Product setup guides & manuals
- 30-day returns policy
- Weight adjustment systems
- Home fitness solutions
